_comment_family: Forma DJR is a superfamily — Text, Micro, Banner, Deck and Display,
each a separate optical size, each with its own weights. This file is
one cut of one of them, and it is the only one in the folder.
It is the pleasant case: the file's own name ID 1 is already 'Forma
DJR Display Extra Bold' rather than 'Forma DJR Display', so the
family Windows lists it under names this cut and nothing else. The
typographic family (name ID 16) is the shorter 'Forma DJR Display',
and that is the name deliberately NOT declared here: a machine with
the Regular or the Bold of the same optical size installed would
answer to it, and a title measured against the ExtraBold and drawn in
a Regular is not a different look, it is a wrong layout. Same
reasoning as gilroy-extrabold and sharp-grotesk-bold20, arrived at
from the other direction — there the full name had to be assembled,
here the file hands it over.
Weight 800, which is the file's own usWeightClass and what the cut is
called. Asking for 700 would invite a browser to synthesise the
difference on top of a face that already has it.
_comment_css: Not declared in styles.css: this face arrived with a channel and is
registered from this JSON, which is the route content/README.md
describes. Nothing has to be added to the stylesheet for it.

_comment_stack: Damage limitation and never a design choice — a title laid out
against the wrong metrics is broken rather than merely different,
which is what fontguard exists to catch before anything is drawn.
Impact and Arial Black all the same, because this is a heavy display
